primary.root_cause: The output register samples combinational MUX outputs driven by `curr_state` instead of `next_state`, causing a 1-cycle delay and glitch because both registers update simultaneously on the clock edge.
evidence: always_ff @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin ... m_axis_tdata <= mux_tdata;
primary.proposed_fix: Update the MUX select conditions to use `next_state` instead of `curr_state`, ensuring the combinational logic reflects the upcoming state when the output register samples it.

alternative.root_cause: The backpressure stall logic using the `temp` flag deadlocks when `m_axis_tready` is deasserted, as the `temp` flag is never cleared, permanently blocking future output updates.
evidence: if (temp) begin // Stalled: hold previous outputs until ready signal is asserted // temp remains 1 end
alternative.proposed_fix: Restructure the stall logic to check `m_axis_tready` independently of `temp`, clearing the `temp` flag and updating outputs when the downstream ready signal is asserted.
